presets.name: Neutral
presets.intent: Natural quest conversation with no emotion added beyond the text.
presets.direction: Speak naturally and clearly. Preserve the profile's identity without exaggeration.
presets.guardrail: Neutral does not mean flat, bored, or emotionally absent.

presets.name: Angry
presets.intent: Controlled anger with urgency, pressure, or confrontation appropriate to the words.
presets.direction: Increase firmness, pace, and stressed consonants before increasing loudness.
presets.guardrail: Do not default to shouting, distortion, or loss of diction.

presets.name: Sorrowful
presets.intent: Grief, regret, or exhaustion expressed with restraint and specificity.
presets.direction: Allow quieter energy, longer thought pauses, and softened attacks while keeping the line audible.
presets.guardrail: Do not use melodramatic sobbing or make every sorrowful line whispery.

presets.name: Joyful
presets.intent: Warmth, relief, delight, or celebration suited to the text.
presets.direction: Add lift, forward energy, and brighter phrase endings without speeding past words.
presets.guardrail: Do not force laughter, childishness, or constant maximum excitement.

presets.name: Proclaiming
presets.intent: A public declaration meant to carry to a group, battlefield, hall, or ceremony.
presets.direction: Use projected breath, broad stresses, and deliberate phrase endings as if addressing listeners at distance.
presets.guardrail: Projection is not the same as anger or indiscriminate yelling.
